_measured_basis: w_vector is the MMD evidence. It is the only term that can override a prior, which is why it is the largest: the calibrated priors may re-rank two candidates the MMD cannot separate, but they may not overrule a morph that is plainly raised.  w_phoneme is the weight on an externally supplied phoneme or lyric-viseme timeline. It is 0 when no timeline is supplied, so the default is free; nothing in the current pipeline produces one, which is why phoneme_mouth.json is marked UNAVAILABLE.  max_events_per_sec is 0, which means the ceiling comes from the corpus's own p90 event rate in mouth_prototypes.json (5.27 cues/s over 246 performances) rather than from a constant.  It was 9.0, nearly twice the corpus p90; because the merge stage applied it as a per-event floor regardless of the overall rate, it collapsed 72% of a real performance's events and left median events 0.37 s long against a corpus median gap of 0.198 s.  That over-merging, not too many cues, is what produced the held small mouth shape.
